about: Mont-Laurier is a city in the Upper Laurentians of Quebec, on the Rivière du Lièvre along Highway 117 toward the Réserve faunique Rouge-Matawin and parks farther north. Forestry, outdoor recreation, and a role as the region’s main service centre define the place. About 14,000 people live in Mont-Laurier.
seoSummary: Upper Laurentians city on the Lièvre River and Highway 117—forestry and outdoor gateway north of Montréal.
